verdict.rationale: First-party docs say traces can be grouped into datasets, collected from production, rerun through different application versions, and scored with evaluation results compared (docs-41, docs-65). Dataset evaluators, code-based or LLM-as-judge, can be attached in the UI and score experiment results automatically as a unit-test-like harness, and the GitHub README confirms versioned datasets. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the trace-to-dataset curation and offline eval workflow.
